baslik: One Design Change Doubled the Load — and 114 Died

sahneler.metin: Two walkways fell onto a crowded hotel lobby in Kansas City.
In seconds, one hundred fourteen people were dead.
So how does a walkway just drop?
The design used one long rod through both walkways.
During construction, it was swapped for two shorter rods.
That quietly doubled the load on one set of nuts.
Under the crowd, the nuts pulled straight through the beam.
Now every connection change needs the engineer's approval.
